2608.25390.title: Refusal geometry reflects refusal training: diverse refusal prefixes can raise stable rank and weaken refusal vector ablation attacks
2608.25390.paper_summary: Refusal training protects AI models from jailbreaks by training models to decline unsafe queries, reducing the risk of misuse. Recent work finds that refusal behavior in aligned language models can be mediated by a single activation direction or a low-dimensional refusal subspace shared across harmful prompts: ablating those directions suppresses refusals while largely preserves other model capabilities. Yet it remains unclear why safety-critical features in a wide range of models emerge and concentrated, low-dimensional structure. In a case study of OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct we find that the refusal geometry reflects refusal training: activation updates resulting from refusal-completion first-token losses explain the resulting refusal direction and refusal subspace. We study refusal directions through the training dynamics across refusal datasets and reveal that their brittleness is associated with repetitive refusal starts, which in turn is linked to concentration of gradients and refusal features in a low-dimensional subspace. Across frozen-model analyses and controlled synthetic fine-tuning, we find evidence of a hardening lever: diverse refusal starts can raise stable ranks of gradients and activation changes, making refusals harder to remove with a vector ablation attack.
2608.25390.paper_summary_zh: 拒絕訓練透過訓練模型拒絕不安全的查詢來保護 AI 模型免受越獄攻擊，從而降低誤用的風險。最近的研究發現，在對齊的語言模型中，拒絕行為可以通過單一的激活方向或在有害提示中共享的低維拒絕子空間來調節：消除這些方向會抑制拒絕，同時在很大程度上保留其他模型能力。然而，為什麼在各種模型中出現安全關鍵特徵並集中於低維結構仍然不清楚。在 OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct 的案例研究中，我們發現拒絕幾何反映了拒絕訓練：來自拒絕完成首個標記損失的激活更新解釋了最終的拒絕方向和拒絕子空間。我們通過拒絕數據集的訓練動態研究拒絕方向，並揭示它們的脆弱性與重複的拒絕啟動相關，這又與梯度和拒絕特徵在低維子空間中的集中有關。通過冷凍模型分析和受控合成微調，我們發現了一個硬化槓桿的證據：多樣的拒絕啟動可以提高梯度和激活變化的穩定等級，使得使用向量消融攻擊更難以去除拒絕。
2608.25390.author: Andrey Labunets et.al.
